display.method: One whole-scene translation followed by one uniform scale; all original internal transforms and geometry data retained

retained.geometryAttributes: Unchanged POSITION, NORMAL, UV and other original attributes
retained.materialsAndTextures: Unchanged source materials and texture bytes

limitations: Native pooled wheels and doors have no independent animation nodes; no visible wheel spinning or door opening is invented
The original source is longer than the previous stylized coach; simulation spacing must use carSpecRaw and detailLength
Original geometry and full outlines are rendered; no lower-detail profile or shadow proxy is applied
